flags.title: Three covered sports served no matches at all
flags.detail: The Golf (sport 5), Snooker (sport 8) and Motor Racing (sport 14) hubs each rendered 'No tips found.' on 24 October. The Snooker 'All Events' sub-route rendered the same message, so there is no OLBG market to price for any of the three.

flags.title: Rugby League hub carries outrights for 2027 only
flags.detail: The Rugby League hub listed State of Origin 2027, the Super League 2027 Grand Final and the NRL 2027 Grand Final. No upcoming fixture of either 2026 competition was listed, so the sport has no match market on the board.

flags.title: Greyhounds hub carried a single race
flags.detail: One race, '11:04 Doncaster', was listed with a single tip on Snowfall. No GBGB racecard or form was read, so the race is published as a listing and not priced.

flags.title: OLBG start times disagree with the league's own clock
flags.detail: OLBG printed 'Today 19:07' for the fixtures the NHL schedules at 23:00Z (19:00 ET), 'Today 22:07' for a 01:00Z start and 'Today 23:07' for a 02:00Z start. The offset is not constant and OLBG prints no timezone, so every published start time on this desk comes from the league feed instead.

flags.title: One of the league's twelve games could not be individually confirmed
flags.detail: The NHL feed reports twelve games on 24 October. Eleven are confirmed individually in the returned slice. The twelfth, which OLBG lists as MIN Wild @ SEA Kraken, was not in the slice, so that row carries no price and no pick. MTL@WPG on 25 October comes from a different schedule date and is also unpriced.

flags.title: OLBG's basketball hub omits two games the league lists
flags.detail: The official NBA injury report for 24 October lists MIA@CHA and MEM@SAC. Neither appeared on the OLBG basketball hub, which stopped after seven games. Both are published here from the league document.

flags.title: Club names differ between OLBG and the governing body
flags.detail: OLBG bills 'Eastern Storm vs South Africa Emerging'; Cricket South Africa calls the same fixture 'World Sports Betting Eastern Storm vs CSA High Performance'. OLBG also prints 'VGS Golden Knights' where the NHL prints VGK.

flags.title: No basketball totals are originated
flags.detail: No official NBA scoring figure (team points for or against) was read this session, so a total would have been invented. Every NBA row therefore carries moneyline and spread markets only.

flags.title: Detroit's goals for and against were not in the returned page
flags.detail: The NHL team-summary slice that carried Detroit's record cut off before its goals-for and goals-against fields. With no goals rate there is no honest price, so DET@CGY is published with a moneyline and nothing else, and no pick.

flags.title: Ten of the fifteen sports have no priced match
flags.detail: Only ice hockey and basketball reached a priced state. Cricket has six fixtures confirmed on the governing body's own site but no competition record was read, so none is priced. Baseball has one confirmed fixture with both starting pitchers named and no season rate for Milwaukee, so the market is withheld. Tennis, Volleyball, Handball, Rugby Union, Gaelic Sports and Darts were found on OLBG only and are not confirmed by a governing body.

flags.title: The brief's two High-pick rules barely intersect
flags.detail: A selection with a 70% chance has a fair price of about -233; the band's shortest allowed price, -250, implies 71.4%. Requiring both 'more than 70%' and 'inside -250..+10000' therefore leaves a 1.4-point window, and only three of this desk's 88 originated outcomes land in it. The three High picks here are those, plus any other line that lands there after normalisation; nothing was moved into the tier by hand.

flags.title: Basketball records are two games deep
flags.detail: Every NBA club has played between one and two games. Records that short carry almost no information, so each is shrunk toward .500 with a ten-win, ten-loss prior before it is used. That is why no basketball pick reaches the medium tier on record alone and none reaches high at all.

flags.title: OLBG tip shares are not probabilities and were not used
flags.detail: OLBG prints the share of member tips on each selection (for example '10/12 Win Tips, 83%'). Those are votes, not prices, and no number on this desk is derived from them. They appear on the sport pages labelled as OLBG's own tally so the reader can see the difference.

repo_findings.title: Sixteen of ninety session desks are reachable from the published site
repo_findings.detail: The repository carries 90 session desk directories at its root. The ARCHIVE allowlist in pipeline/build.py contains 16 entries, so the other 74 desks are tracked but have no published entry point. The root README still promises that earlier desks 'stay published'.

repo_findings.title: The confidence gate differs between the README and the brief
repo_findings.detail: README.md defines High as 'originated probability >= 60% and fair American price in [-250, +10000]'. The brief defines high confidence as a selection with more than a 70% chance. Both cannot be true of the same pick, and different desks in this repository have used different thresholds, so the tiers are not comparable across desks.

repo_findings.title: A 10.5 MB generated artefact is tracked
repo_findings.detail: data/current/audit.json is 10,473,214 bytes and is committed. The repository tracks 3,032 files for what is a static predictions site; most of that weight is generated JSON that is regenerated by the build rather than read by it.

repo_findings.title: No broken relative page links in the twenty root pages
repo_findings.detail: All twenty root HTML pages were parsed and every relative .html link was resolved against the filesystem. Zero were missing. This is a clean result and is recorded so that the negative finding is explicit.

repo_findings.title: The shared task board is 849 KB and is append-only
repo_findings.detail: COORDINATION.md is 849,056 bytes and is edited by every session under an append-only rule. Two different sections were both numbered 74 and two are both numbered 75, so cross-references to a section number are ambiguous. Claims are also still listed as 'in progress' for sessions that finished days ago.

repo_findings.title: The existing test suite is green before this session's changes
repo_findings.detail: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/pipeline passes on the branch head this desk was built from, and scripts/validate.py returns no errors. This desk adds its own test module rather than editing the shared suite.
